title: Drømmekage
subtitle: Danish Dream Cake
description: A classic Danish sponge cake finished with a caramelized coconut and brown sugar topping, baked right on top of the cake until golden and bubbling.

sections.name: Sponge
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease and line a 9-inch springform pan.
Whisk flour, baking powder, and salt together; set aside.
Whisk eggs and sugar until pale and fluffy (3–4 min).
Gently heat milk and butter until melted; stir in vanilla.
Fold dry ingredients into egg mixture, then stir in warm milk mixture — don't overmix.
Pour into pan, bake 20 min (it'll be underdone — that's fine).

sections.name: Coconut Topping & Assembly
ingredients: ¾ cup + 2 tbsp light brown sugar
steps: While the cake bakes, melt butter for the topping in a saucepan; stir in brown sugar, coconut, and milk. Cook 2–3 min until bubbly.
Spread the topping over the partially baked cake, return to oven for 15–20 min until golden and bubbling.
Cool 15–20 min in the pan before releasing. Serve warm or room temp.

tip: Watch the topping closely near the end — coconut burns fast.
